title: I Took the Extra-Credit Rubric to the Extra Credit They Denied

parts.text: I wrote the extra-credit essay because the rubric said anyone under 80 could submit by Friday. I had a 77. I turned it in Thursday. Monday the teacher said extra credit was really for students he "knew were trying," and I was already trying his patience. I was seventeen. I printed the rubric, my 77, the timestamp. The department chair keeps office hours that smell like pencil shavings. She applied the rubric. I got the points. He told the class I had gone over his head. I had gone to the paper he wrote. Pencil shavings are a kind of justice. I still had a 77 plus. Trying looks like a timestamp.

social.video_title: The rubric knew I was trying before he did — Part 1/1
social.description: 77, Friday deadline, Thursday submit, personality grading. Would you have gone to the chair?
